QuestInfo.0: Visit one of the Big 3 attractions,  the Gyro Drop, at the #e#b#m223020100##k#n.\n
QuestInfo.1: The Gyro Drop is under repair. Climb to the top and see if you can figure out what is causing the malfunction.
